sourceNotes.title: ABOUT US
sourceNotes.bodyHtml: IGENU company (igloo, referred to as IG) is a set of design and manufacture of environmental monitoring instruments, industrial automation instrument as one of professional manufacturers, the products cover the water quality analysis, gas analysis, liquid (matter) measurement, flow measurement, pressure measurement, industrial instrumentation, automatic analysis instrument in the field of well-known the brand in the world. Founded in 1982, IG is headquartered in 209 Douglas West Road, Hamburg, Germany, and has more than 20 branches in the world. Over 1600 employees are engaged in research, development, production, sales and maintenance. In Germany, the United States, Australia, France, the United Kingdom, Singapore and China and other countries, there are production and sales centers, and their strict quality management and complete quality assurance system have reached the ISO9001 international standard. Over the past 30 years, IG company through close contact with the market and technological innovation, experience high quality standard system and more than 30 years of achievements of the IG products with diversified varieties and wide application range, high sensitivity and versatility of the characteristics of the one and only in the industrial field, special champion. We also ensure that we provide continuous technical support for our customers, and our employees will give customers the right and effective advice and solutions in real time. At present, the products of IG have been sold to many countries and regions all over the world. They are widely used in drinking water, waste water, waste gas treatment, industrial safety and other industries in municipal, environmental protection and other fields.
